method: Initial products only. Reference assets inside AOI; >=80% footprint area or length-weighted samples jointly eligible for water AND debris. Missing class observations cannot establish negative exposure. Pre-event OSM matching: 50m point distance / >=50% road length within 30m. Uncertain grades excluded from binary agreement.

buildings.reason: No positive, jointly observed, matched reference/prediction asset comparisons.

roads.reason: No positive, jointly observed, matched reference/prediction asset comparisons.

attribution: European Union, Copernicus Emergency Management Service data
limitations: Exposure-versus-grading agreement is indirect: intersection does not establish structural damage, impassability or actual settlement cutoff. Matching and observation selection affect coverage; excluded assets are reported explicitly.
